purpose: Establish external evidence custody, cross-host reconciliation, independent evaluation, release readiness, and a bounded loopback service boundary without self-asserting independence or promotion.
candidate_freeze_rule: The Wave Three system and Wave Four service boundary identities are frozen before any protected corpus disclosure.
promotion_rule: Promotion is prohibited unless every required MNCS and MNCDS gate is PASS and release authorization is PASS.
protected_evidence_rule: Development participants cannot act as protected corpus custodian or independent evaluator.
cross_host_rule: At least two distinct host environments must agree on system, epoch, component, tool, and semantic output identities.
selection_rule: Wave Four makes no performance-based candidate selection.
